Billing Period

Plans are billed one calendar month in advance with $0 activation fee. There is no minimum term, no lock-in, and no early termination charge — you may cancel at any time. The only exception is the $200 fibre upgrade early termination fee described below, which may apply if you cancel or change providers within 12 months of receiving a free fibre upgrade.

Setup Fees

Setup fees are $0. No lock-in contract.

Free Fibre Upgrade (nbn Fibre Connect) Fee

If your address is eligible, you may be offered a free upgrade to Fibre to the Premises (FTTP) under nbn's Fibre Connect program. The installation is free on the condition that the upgraded service remains active on an eligible speed-tier plan for 12 months from activation. If, within those 12 months, you cancel your service, transfer to another provider, or downgrade below the minimum eligible speed tier, nbn may charge Neptune Internet a $200 fibre upgrade early termination fee, which may be passed on to you. nbn does not always charge this fee, but where it does, it may apply regardless of your reason for cancelling or transferring — including if you sell your home or move out. After the 12-month period, no fee applies.

Learn more on our Fibre Upgrade page.

Cancelling Your Plan

You may cancel your plan at any time using your customer portal.

As a gesture of goodwill, Neptune Internet will automatically issue a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of your billing period when you cancel mid-cycle. However, the following fees already incurred will be retained:

  • Payment processing fees charged by our payment processor, Stripe: 1.7% of the transaction amount + A$0.30 for domestic cards, or 3.5% + A$0.30 for international cards.
  • NBN service transfer fee of A$5.50 (incl. GST), if the service is cancelled during the first calendar month of service.
  • Fibre upgrade early termination fee of $200, which may apply if you received a free fibre upgrade under the nbn Fibre Connect program and cancel, transfer to another provider, or downgrade below the minimum eligible speed tier within 12 months of the upgraded FTTP service being activated.

Payment terms

  • All service plans are paid at the beginning of each billing period, which is a calendar month.
  • If payment fails, we will retry 1 day after the initial failure, then 3 days after that, then 5 days after that. On the third retry the service is rate limited; 5 days later it is suspended; 2 days after suspension it is disconnected from the NBN network unless the customer has contacted us and arranged payment assistance. Customers who are in financial difficulty may be entitled to assistance from us as described by our Payment Assistance Policy.
  • You can change your service plan at any time during the billing period, and any charges will be prorated in your next invoice.
  • You can cancel your service any time using your customer portal.

Technician Fees

  • Missed appointment / late cancellation fee — Fibre (FTTP): $0 for the first occurrence, $75 (excl. GST) thereafter. HFC, FTTC, FTTB, FTTN: $75 (excl. GST) from the first occurrence. Appointments must be cancelled or rescheduled with at least 2 business days' notice.
  • No Fault Found (NFF) fee — $150 (excl. GST). Applies if a technician callout determines the issue is with your own equipment, internal wiring, or configuration rather than the nbn network or Neptune Internet's services.

Required Equipment

If your home doesn’t already have the right nbn® equipment, a technician will visit to install it. We'll let you know the date and time after you sign up. The equipment stays owned, serviced, and maintained by nbn®. If you'd like your router set up somewhere other than next to the nbn® NTD, you'll need to organise your own internal wiring. Neptune can't provide or support this wiring. You'll also need an approved nbn®-compatible router for your devices.

Customer Support

Our Australian-based accounts and support team are available Monday – Sunday from 9am-8pm (AEST). Contact via the chat widget on the website, or email support@neptune.net.au.

Complaints

If you aren't happy with our service or wish to make a complaint, chat with us on our website or email support@neptune.net.au. You may read more about our complaints handling process here.

If the issue is unresolved you can contact the Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman by phone on 1800 062 058 or visit tio.com.au/about-us/contact-us if you'd like an independent investigation.

Privacy

Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and disclose your personal information.
